{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Wool blend overcoat, straight cut, knee-length, charcoal grey (#36454F), heavy twill fabric
Silk blouse with a subtle sheen, tailored fit, crisp white (#FFFFFF), smooth silk crepe material
High-waisted wool trousers, tapered leg, cropped just above the ankle, slate blue (#3D4C53), fine merino wool knit
Leather ankle boots, classic pointed toe, mid-calf height, deep brown (#4B3621), full-grain leather construction

This outfit works because it perfectly balances professional polish with the practical warmth needed for a walk into the office on a minus eight-degree day. The structured overcoat and wool trousers provide essential insulation against the deep frost while maintaining a clean, neat silhouette suitable for work. Choosing a silk blouse adds a touch of refined texture that elevates the look from basic casual to smart professional without violating any style restrictions. The dark, cool color palette harmonizes with the autumn daylight and keeps the overall appearance grounded and sophisticated."}
